correctness.rationale: For all n>=3, minimum solutions have gaps <=3 and global defect 3ceil(n/3)-n in {0,1,2}. Any all-positive query support imposes modular lower bounds on defects of its arcs; adjacent zero-defect arcs force forbidden middle labels. A lone alternating four-gap configuration is excluded by the unique length-two step on the complementary arc. For sufficiency, the C4/C5/C7 witnesses lift by 3-subdivisions of arbitrary edges, preserving all original traces. Stars-and-bars on cyclic gaps yields every coefficient, and independent exhaustive checks cover n=3..22 and 1,420 edge lifts. No finite extrapolation is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The 2020 full description of minimum dominating sets is prior and credited, but no inspected paper or published-finding corpus finding states a coordinate-shattering test, the three-residue face polynomial, or the defect-exhaustion obstruction. The nearest published-finding corpus cycle study uses inclusion-minimal (not minimum-cardinality) domination; the nearest minimum-independent study is on paths. Searches cannot prove absolute priority, and the possibility of an indexed-or-unindexed equivalent remains a stated residual risk.
residual_risks: An equivalent all-order trace classification could be implicit in later unindexed combinatorics/learning-theory literature or appear under gamma-set hypergraph terminology.
The optimal-set descriptions published in 2020 are strong inputs; priority is confined to explicit Boolean trace/shattering classification and proof, not the configuration or hypothesis census.
published-finding corpus and accessible sources are not exhaustive of all historical literature or inaccessible sources.

value.rationale: The minimum domination number and enumeration of gamma-sets do not determine which arbitrarily prescribed membership labels can coexist. The new all-size residue-only shattering tests and face polynomial describe the complete simplicial shattering structure of a classical optimizing family, with genuine n mod 3 changes in VC dimension and maximum support size. This is a natural invariant driven by optimal domination, not an arbitrary finite calculation.
